items.title: Henry "Sleepy" Robertson Interview, 1961-09-22
items.q: Son, few clothes, son White, old time drummers.

ctx.x: Son, few clothes, son White, old time drummers. He's been out. He was on back there. Old, old time drummers. Good drummers too. Now we got one now, now...I can't think of him, but he wasn't about no old time, but he got George Williams, well he's not no old time. George Williams started playing music a few years ago. He was young, right? Yeah.
